Kit summary

Poisonous CycloneBasicExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Deals 270% ATK [Poison] DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Poison] for 2 turns. If [Poison] owned by the target has been stacked to 10 layers, increases DMG dealt by Poisonous Cyclone to 200% of the original.
Windstorm Wheel Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, Willa casts 1 extra Wind of Potential immediately. Each time an ally gains [Counterattack] because of [Storm Blessing], Willa casts Poisonous Cyclone to pursue and attack a random enemy for once.
Windstorm Wheel Lv.2Increases Willa's Basic Attack DMG by 15%, gains 1 layer of [Rising Wind] after casting Wind of Potential each time (each layer increases Basic Attack DMG by 5%, up to 5 layers can be owned). After casting Poisonous Cyclone each time, reduces the CD of Awakening Hurricane by 1 turn.
Wind of PotentialActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Grants all allies [Storm Blessing] for 3 turns, increasing their ATK and DEF by 40% of Willa's initial ATK. When the ally with [Storm Blessing] successfully inflicts [Poison] or deals [Poison] DMG, grants the ally [Counterattack] for 2 turns. This effect can only be triggered once after gaining [Storm Blessing] each time.
Windstorm Wheel Lv.1At the beginning of each wave, Willa casts 1 extra Wind of Potential immediately. Each time an ally gains [Counterattack] because of [Storm Blessing], Willa casts Poisonous Cyclone to pursue and attack a random enemy for once.
Windstorm Wheel Lv.2Increases Willa's Basic Attack DMG by 15%, gains 1 layer of [Rising Wind] after casting Wind of Potential each time (each layer increases Basic Attack DMG by 5%, up to 5 layers can be owned). After casting Poisonous Cyclone each time, reduces the CD of Awakening Hurricane by 1 turn.
Fresh BreezePassive
When enemies act for 3 turns continuously or the same enemy acts for 2 turns continuously, if Willa does not have [Well-prepared], casts Hypnotizing Breeze to counterattack once immediately and gains [Well-prepared]. Hypnotizing Breeze: Deals 100% ATK [Poison] DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict [Hypnotize] for 1 turn. Willa can still cast Hypnotizing Breeze to counterattack even if she is under Control status, [Well-prepared] will be removed after Awakening Hurricane is cast.
Awakening HurricaneActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Attacks all enemies, dealing 3 stages of 110% ATK [Poison] DMG each. The first stage has a 100% chance to inflict [SPD Down II] for 2 turns. When a certain number of allies have the [Poison] tag, gains the following effects: 2 or more: The second stage has a 100% chance to additionally inflict [Crit DMG Down II] for 2 turns. 4 or more: The third stage has a 100% chance to additionally inflict [ATK Down II] for 2 turns.
Windstorm Wheel Lv.2Increases Willa's Basic Attack DMG by 15%, gains 1 layer of [Rising Wind] after casting Wind of Potential each time (each layer increases Basic Attack DMG by 5%, up to 5 layers can be owned). After casting Poisonous Cyclone each time, reduces the CD of Awakening Hurricane by 1 turn.
Windstorm Wheel Lv.3Hypnotizing Breeze is enhanced: 1. Inflicted [Hypnotize] cannot be blocked. 2. Reduces all enemies' Turn Meters by 12%. 3. For every 1 ally with the [Poison] tag deployed, increases all allies' Turn Meters by 6%, up to 24% can be increased. Besides, if [Well-prepared] is not owned when casting Awakening Hurricane, additionally casts Hypnotizing Breeze for once after Awakening Hurricane ends, which is considered as counterattack.
